p: altar of shittim wood: For the burnt offering.
the same: Of the same wood and matter not fastened to it.
court of the tabernacle: This was the first entry into the tabernacle, where the people abode.
fillets shall be of silver: They were certain hoops or circles to beautify the pillar.
fifty cubits: Meaning curtains of fifty cubits.
side of the gate shall be: Of the door of the court.
pins thereof: Or stakes, with which the curtains were fastened to the ground.
beaten for the light: Such as comes from the olive, when it is first pressed or beaten.
